note: Thresholds for workload rules R-IOT-1, R-FH-1, R-BR-1, R-BR-2. Every value carries its evidence level: '실험 확인' (reproduced in this repository's synthetic experiments), '공식 자료' (AWS documentation or price list, checked 2026-11-13), '임시값' (provisional; re-derive from real account data).

kb_definitions_bytes.source: AWS IoT Core pricing: messages metered in 5 KB increments; byte definition unconfirmed, so both are evaluated (experiment 016)

batch_size_limit_bytes.source: 5% margin under the 5,000 B boundary (experiment 016 H3)

metering_tolerance.source: allowed relative gap between metered and expected metered messages

record_unit_bytes.source: Amazon Data Firehose pricing: billed per GB ingested in 5KB increments

supported_profiles.source: Only Global cross-Region rates for Claude were found in the Seoul price list

ttl_seconds.source: Amazon Bedrock prompt caching: 5 minute TTL, 1 hour option

min_cache_tokens.source: Bedrock prompt caching supported-models table; Sonnet 4.5 not listed (null = unknown)

min_observed_cache_writes.source: minimum cache-write calls before judging a hit ratio
